# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 78 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 78 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_078_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 8 — The Great Willow Tree

**1** He showed me an enormous willow tree whose canopy spread over plains and mountains alike. Gathered in its shade were all those who bear the name of the Lord. **2** Standing beside the willow was a magnificent angel — tall and radiant — holding a great sickle. He was cutting branches from the willow and handing them out to the people sheltered beneath it. Each person received a small branch, about a foot long. **3** When everyone had received their branch, the angel set down his sickle — and the tree was still whole, as full as before. **4** I was astonished. "How can the tree still be whole after losing so many branches?" The Shepherd told me, "Don't be surprised. Wait until you've seen it all — then you'll understand what it means." **5** Then the angel asked everyone to return the branches they had been given. They came up to him one by one in the same order they had received them, and each handed back their branch. The angel examined each one carefully. **6** Some returned branches that were completely dried out and eaten through by worms. The angel told those people to stand off to one side. **7** Others returned branches that were dried out but not worm-eaten. They too were told to stand aside. **8** Some returned branches that were half-withered. They stood aside as well. **9** Some returned branches half-withered and cracked. They too stood apart. **10** Some returned branches that were green but cracked. They also stood aside. **11** Some returned branches half-green and half-withered. They were put to one side. **12** Others brought branches two-thirds green and one-third withered. They stood apart. **13** Others returned branches two-thirds withered and one-third green. They stood apart too. **14** Some returned branches almost entirely green — only the very tip had dried out. These stood apart. **15** And finally, some returned their branches completely green. These stood apart, and the angel was overjoyed at the sight of them, and so was the Shepherd.

---

*PNEUMA renders the systematic grading of branches as a spiritual audit — each condition corresponding to a category of believers explored in following chapters.*
